summary: Add unconnected read-only support metadata and Git contract selection helpers for normal iOS updates.

replay.detail: No event replay change; no active delivery caller is added.

schema.detail: No database or active policy format changes; the helpers accept explicit arguments only.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, approval or fleet coordination rules change.

compatibility.detail: No client or wire behavior changes. Source closure equality and support-only parsing do not assert device compatibility or authorization.

downtime.detail: No service or device changes; network observation and effect wiring remain absent.

manual.detail: No operator action is required. Activation provenance and live serving identity integration remain separate work.

recovery.detail: No active recovery change; malformed metadata returns a validation error and no updater path is changed.
